P2: 'the five new routes' (RT1/RT7/T7) include GET /surface/approve/{id} and approve.js, which are sprint 3's; sprint 2 registers and tests three
P3: R8's 'the CLI's own refusal text (approveAdmission)' cannot be shared from package main; reproduced word for word in surfacepage.AdmissionRefusal (AM3)
P4: RT10/T12's 'the page retries 3 times' is sprint 3's page; sprint 2 pins the daemon half
P5: R13's 'below v7 -> 503 Restart' is detected by RecordSurfaceApproval's S1 after the open (same status/class); below 6 by the judge's store step
P6: RT11's refusal classes are the handler's own (422/400), proving neither the middleware nor a session/cookie decides; isProtected asserted unchanged
P7: RT2's pending cap cannot be exceeded through the store (PutMintRequest refuses the 17th); the decided cap (20) is pinned
